source: Kaggle dataset mikoajfish99/us-recession-and-financial-indicators (FRED CPIAUCSL, CPI-U all items, seasonally adjusted)

columns.CPI_INDEX_SA: index level (1982-84 = 100) of the PREVIOUS month: row r holds the level of month r - 1, knowable 15 days after that month ends

point_in_time: FIXED, documented assumptions (not fetched release vintages; ALFRED is unreachable here). A period's value is re-keyed to the first month-end at or after (period end + lag), so the value on row M is knowable by M's own end.
caveat: The seasonally adjusted series as it stands today: seasonal factors are re-estimated for years after publication, so a level here can differ slightly from the one first published (the real-time vintage is not reachable from this environment).
